verdicts.reason: A: The left-to-right banner order of logo, headline and CTA works. However, the 'Chase / the Light' headline is oversized and nearly fills the canvas height. A bokeh dot sits right behind 'Line' in the CTA, and the small logo leaves dead space on the left. B: 'Chase the / Light' breaks awkwardly and leaves 'Light' orphaned on its own line. The CTA is squeezed into a four-line stack ('Shop / the / Summer / Line') that runs nearly edge to edge vertically and reads badly, with bokeh dots colliding with the text.
